title: NVIDIA announces 30-billion-parameter Nemotron 3 Large Telco Model
excerpt: The new model is fine-tuned on open source telecom datasets to assist with network configuration and customer incident triage.
bodyHtml:
NVIDIA announced the 30-billion-parameter Nemotron 3 Large Telco Model on October 6, 2026. The model was fine-tuned by AdaptKey using open source telecom datasets to improve accuracy for specific industry tasks.

The model provides an open baseline designed to understand telecom terminology and reason through operational workflows. This includes tasks such as network configuration and customer incident triage.

NVIDIA also released a full recipe that walks through the end-to-end fine-tuning pipeline for adapting open models to operator-specific networks, customers and procedures using NVIDIA NeMo open libraries.

According to NVIDIA, 89% of respondents in its latest State of AI in Telecommunications report stated that open source models and software are important to their company’s AI strategy. The company provides an end-to-end platform for these models, powered by NVIDIA AI Enterprise software and the NVIDIA Agent Toolkit.
